title: The Batman
tagline: Riddles in the rain. Stew by the fire.
about: In his second year as Batman, Bruce follows a serial killer's riddles into Gotham's corruption.
cue: Serve the snacks when Batman and Gordon walk into the Iceberg Lounge.
faces: CASH AT THE DOOR. NO QUESTIONS
“Eat something, pal. Nobody does honest crime on an empty stomach.”
Riddles in the rain. Stew by the fire.
Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives
Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche, olives warmed with orange peel.
Soft pretzels shaped as question marks, dipped in bicarb water.
Beef chuck stewed with onions, stout and thyme.
Alfred keeping Bruce going in the old Wayne Tower.
Dark chocolate cream pots set in small glasses.
Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken cold.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the Riddler's cards and green envelopes at the tables. Card No. 2022. Showtime: Serve the snacks when Batman and Gordon walk into the Iceberg Lounge.

sprigs1kg potatoes100g butterBrown the beef in batches.Add the onions and soften, then pour in the stout and enough water to cover.Add the thyme, cover and simmer gently until tender.Boil the
